nodes.description: Public address state variable 'owner' storing the deployer/owner account; read by the restricted modifier and written in the constructor.
Public uint state variable 'last_completed_migration' written by setCompleted.
Constructor of Migrations that initializes owner from the deploying caller.
Public setCompleted(uint) function guarded by the restricted modifier that writes last_completed_migration.
restricted modifier that checks msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function body.
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for owner assignment and the access-control comparison.
State-mutating write last_completed_migration = completed, reachable only if the msg.sender == owner access-control check passes.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned into the owner state variable in the constructor, establishing the privileged account.
owner state variable is read inside the restricted modifier to authorize the caller.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the restricted modifier's access-control check.
The restricted modifier gates execution of setCompleted based on the caller identity.
Caller-controlled msg.sender determines whether setCompleted executes at all via the modifier.
The completed parameter is the value written by the state write operation in setCompleted.
setCompleted executes the state write operation on last_completed_migration.
The state write mutates last_completed_migration using the provided uint value, an unchecked assignment.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter 'completed' has no independent behavior; it is consumed solely as the value of the state write operation in setCompleted and can be merged into it.
